packages.title: Repository, operating law, constraint checker, and CI
packages.owned_scope: workspace root, `cairn-check`, CI configuration, `LAW.md`, architecture-decision-record template
packages.objective: Create the enforceable project boundary before any inference code exists.
packages.deliverables: A compilable Rust workspace, machine-enforced policy checks, CI jobs, reproducible toolchain pinning, and self-tests that prove each prohibition fires.
packages.acceptance_criteria: Clean workspace passes; all planted violations fail with stable machine-readable codes; checker runtime below 5 s on the repository; runtime attestation schema validates; CI runs formatting, clippy with warnings denied, unit tests, policy check, and artifact-schema validation.

packages.title: Canonical serialization, content-addressed storage, and artifact envelopes
packages.owned_scope: cairn-core`, `cairn-cas`, shared hash and artifact schemas
packages.objective: Provide immutable, replayable, cross-process artifacts with stable semantic identity.
packages.deliverables: Canonical CBOR encoder/decoder, BLAKE3 IDs, append-only CAS, artifact validation, schema/version negotiation, and crash-safe local storage.
packages.acceptance_criteria: Identical semantic values produce identical bytes and IDs across repeat runs; 10 million small artifact round trips without mismatch; concurrent idempotent writes; recovery after forced process termination; cached 1 MB blob read throughput above 1 GB/s on baseline storage or documented machine-normalized equivalent.

packages.title: Packed finite spatial fields and CPU geometry kernels
packages.objective: Deliver an exact high-throughput finite spatial-field service for raster-like frontends without making cognition depend on grids or categorical meanings.
packages.deliverables: Generic finite fields, packed masks, index sets, transforms, components under supplied adjacency, geometry, rasterization, overlay, and naive references.
packages.acceptance_criteria: All generic reference comparisons pass across multiple element types and dimensions; component labeling median is below 3 microseconds on representative 30 by 30 fields; common masks exceed 20 million operations per core per second; no ARC vocabulary or semantic categorical roles enter the API.

packages.title: Relational Evidence Graph and query indexes
packages.objective: Implement the typed attributed hypergraph that holds observations, entities, relations, events, roles, and derivations efficiently.
packages.deliverables: Arena-based REG, specialized relation indexes, snapshots, deterministic query engine, and artifact serialization.
packages.acceptance_criteria: At least 10 million indexed binary-relation probes per second; a common two-join query is below 50 microseconds on frozen generated graphs from three domain schemas; memory is below 20 MB for a deliberately overcomplete 10,000-fact graph; artifacts round-trip canonically; no spatial or adapter dependency.

packages.title: Relational Kernel Language types, AST, bounds, and canonical form
packages.objective: Define a small universal bounded relational language with explicit types and totality rules.
packages.deliverables: Typed AST, parser for debug fixtures, type checker, range and collection-bound inference, alpha-normalization, semantic hash input, and cost model hooks.
packages.acceptance_criteria: 100,000 random well-typed terms canonicalize and typecheck deterministically; all generated values fall inside inferred bounds; alpha-equivalent theories hash identically; checker errors carry precise source path and expected/actual types.

packages.title: Reference and optimized RKL execution
packages.owned_scope: cairn-bytecode` plus reference interpreter module in `cairn-rkl
packages.objective: Execute any valid bounded theory exactly, safely, and fast enough for millions of candidate evaluations.
packages.deliverables: Slow reference interpreter, typed bytecode compiler, optimized executor, execution traces, fuel accounting, and semantic equivalence tests.
packages.acceptance_criteria: Zero differential mismatches across scalar, relation, finite-field, rule, and transition theories; optimized simple theory execution is below 50 microseconds on frozen spatial and non-spatial cases; compiled candidates are reused without hot-loop allocation; trace-off overhead is below 10%; errors are stable and typed.

packages.title: Proof DAGs, replay certificates, and independent verifier
packages.objective: Create the trust boundary that independently establishes exact execution and artifact lineage.
packages.deliverables: Proof data model, demonstration replay, prediction/transition/plan certificates, adapter hooks, cross-implementation checker, corruption diagnostics, and compact proof hashes.
packages.acceptance_criteria: Verifier catches all planted corruptions and agrees with the reference interpreter on one million cases across three schemas; replay uses no synthesis, memory, spatial, or adapter crate in core semantics; typical small-problem certificate is below 1 MB; median verification is below 20 ms.

packages.title: Demand-driven entity algebra
packages.objective: Generate and cache only relation-defined entity hypotheses relevant to an active explanation hole across modalities.
packages.deliverables: Generic entity-expression evaluator, denotation cache, demand API, extension traits for frontend relations, cost tiers, equivalence signatures, and provenance.
packages.acceptance_criteria: Useful entity hypotheses are recovered on frozen grid, gridworld, and vector-scene suites; demand-driven mode materializes at least 60% fewer entities than each frozen broad parse baseline; exact provenance is retained; no spatial or ARC type is required by the core API.

packages.title: Spatial structure evidence frontend
packages.objective: Translate finite spatial fields into cheap provenance-backed structural evidence without adding detector semantics to cognition crates.
packages.deliverables: Generic evidence facts with confidence, source references, derivations, detector benchmarks, adapter-conformance tests, and manual-audit fixtures.
packages.acceptance_criteria: Zero false exact facts on the committed detector suite; heuristic precision and recall are separate; median is below 30 ms per moderate field; each result has a reproducible derivation and supporting index set; no detector type crosses the frontend boundary.

packages.title: Generic event and source-target correspondence hypothesis generation
packages.objective: Generate a compact structurally diverse set of causal event hypotheses from generic before/after or observation/action/outcome evidence.
packages.deliverables: Preserve, update, move, transform, rebind, copy, create, delete, split, merge, aggregate, distribute, and control event hypotheses with frontend-supplied feature indexes.
packages.acceptance_criteria: Correct event kind and source-target set is top-five on at least 98% of single-event generated cases across three domains; top-twenty on at least 95% of two-event cases; spatial detectors are optional proposal providers rather than dependencies; cap reasons are reported.

packages.title: Exact demonstration event-cover optimization
packages.objective: Select top structurally distinct event sets that exactly explain a generic demonstration transition.
packages.deliverables: Demonstration event covers, replay plans, unmatched evidence cores, cover diversity signatures, and optimization metrics.
packages.acceptance_criteria: An exact cover is top-eight for at least 95% of two-event generated transitions across three domains; replay correctness is 100%; p95 is below 200 ms on the component suites; top-k covers are structurally distinct; controlled omission cores classify at least 90%.

packages.title: Cross-demonstration analogical alignment and anti-unification
packages.objective: Map causal roles and relations across generic demonstrations and produce typed rule sketches independent of adapter identity.
packages.deliverables: Role mappings, event clusters, preserved-relation scores, alignment modes, and anti-unified sketches.
packages.acceptance_criteria: Correct abstract role alignment in top three for at least 95% of synthetic suite; at least 90% on multirule suite; relation preservation beats appearance-only baseline by at least 15 points; median below 100 ms for small tasks and p95 below 1 s.

packages.title: Typed e-graph and goal-directed equality saturation
packages.objective: Compact equivalent predicates, features, coordinate expressions, and constructors while preserving proof scope.
packages.deliverables: Typed e-classes, e-class analyses, scoped observational equivalence, goal-directed saturation, and k-best extraction.
packages.acceptance_criteria: At least 10 times syntactic deduplication on generated equivalent-expression suites; k-best extraction exact against brute force for small classes; 100,000-node stress within declared memory; goal-directed run below 100 ms for typical guard holes; no cross-task observational equality leakage.

packages.title: Incremental finite-domain SAT and MaxSAT backend
packages.objective: Provide deterministic incremental solving, model blocking, optimization, and unsat explanation behind a stable trait.
packages.deliverables: Backend abstraction, first production SAT backend, weighted or lexicographic optimization, assumption scopes, metrics, and core extraction.
packages.acceptance_criteria: All brute-force comparisons pass; solve 100,000-variable sparse synthetic problem within measured target chosen in pre-registration; incremental re-solve at least 5 times faster than rebuild on CEGIS fixture; deterministic selected model under CAIRN canonical tie-breaking.

packages.title: Contextual guard and selector induction
packages.objective: Learn minimal relational clauses that select transformed bindings and reject hard negatives.
packages.deliverables: Guard hypotheses, decision lists when required, separation reports, and failure constraints.
packages.acceptance_criteria: At least 95% held-out selector accuracy on T0 suite; exact demonstration positives and negatives; full system at least 3 times fewer guard candidates than naive enumeration; emitted guard has replayable binding explanation.

packages.title: Constructor and coordinate-expression synthesis
packages.objective: Synthesize exact variable-arity outcome structures, placement, shape, categorical values, and observation-relative geometry where present from provenance evidence.
packages.deliverables: Constructor expressions, relation anchors, optional coordinate formulas, categorical-value functions, group mappings, and construction proofs.
packages.acceptance_criteria: At least 95% held-out exact output on T1 variable-arity suite; at least 85% on multicolor construction suite; every emitted cell has source or bounded constructor provenance; p95 below 5 s for invention-tier cases and below 500 ms for base-tier cases.

packages.title: Operator-valued symbol interpretation
packages.objective: Infer when visual tokens act as instructions and bind them to values, predicates, operators, constructors, roles, or schedule choices.
packages.deliverables: Symbol-control hypotheses, mapping constraints, operator-valued bindings, and negative-control diagnostics.
packages.acceptance_criteria: At least 90% held-out exact task solve on T3 suite; at least 80% operator-valued cases; unrelated-symbol false control below 2%; leave-one-out mapping report; runtime below 2 s median on suite.

packages.title: Rule schedule, dependency DAG, canvas, and renderer synthesis
packages.objective: Infer how multiple rules interact and how their effects become the exact output canvas.
packages.deliverables: Parallel/sequence/decision/fixpoint schedules, dependency DAGs, canvas expressions, layer order, and conflict proofs.
packages.acceptance_criteria: At least 90% semantic schedule recovery on T2; at least 85% exact interacting-rule solves; 100% bound proofs for fixpoints; renderer reproduces all selected event covers; p95 below 2 s on synthetic suite.

packages.title: Theory weaver and semantic frontier
packages.objective: Assemble aligned events, guards, constructors, symbols, schedules, and renderers into complete multi-rule theory candidates.
packages.deliverables: Theory sketches, joint constraint problems, complete candidates, semantic mode hashes, and anytime frontier state.
packages.acceptance_criteria: On T0–T3 combined suite, complete correct theory in top fifty executed candidates for at least 90% of solved cases; no duplicate semantic theory execution above 1%; checkpoint/resume byte-identical results; memory caps produce typed terminal state.

packages.title: Counterexample-guided refinement and learning from failures
packages.objective: Turn exact execution failures into semantic pruning constraints and focused follow-up jobs.
packages.deliverables: Structured counterexamples, minimized explanation cores, pruning clauses, refinement jobs, and unrealizability certificates.
packages.acceptance_criteria: T5 shows at least 3 times fewer complete candidate executions and 2 times lower p95 than rejection-only; no valid theory pruned on exhaustive small suites; core classification at least 90% on controlled omissions.

packages.title: Dynamic predicate, role, constructor, and recursive-definition invention
packages.objective: Expand the task-local practical language from explanation cores while remaining grounded in RKL.
packages.deliverables: Definition proposals, totality proofs, separation/compression reports, task-local admission, and promotion candidates.
packages.acceptance_criteria: T4 gate: at least 70% of omitted-vocabulary cases solved, negative false positives below 2%, every accepted definition exact and total, median invention below 10 s, no task IDs or opaque native semantics.

packages.title: Falsification, theory ranking, ambiguity management, and pass@2
packages.objective: Rank exact theories by internal predictive evidence and emit two credible distinct output modes.
packages.deliverables: Leave-one-out reports, equivariance results, perturbation stability, semantic modes, belief weights, and attempt selection.
packages.acceptance_criteria: A0 at least 8-point ambiguous-task improvement over MDL-only; A1 pass@2 at least 10 points over best single mode in controlled suite; duplicate second outputs below 1%; exact training fit never relaxed.

packages.title: Quarantined ARC-AGI-1/2 adapter and task runner
packages.objective: Losslessly translate official ARC records into generic learning problems without introducing ARC semantics into cognition crates.
packages.deliverables: Strict JSON parser, adapter lowering and round-trip proofs, split capability separation, answer writer, suite runner, and development-only visualization.
packages.acceptance_criteria: All official public task files parse; malformed fixtures are rejected precisely; cognition crates remain ARC-vocabulary-free; adapter round-trip is exact; ordinary development binaries cannot enumerate evaluation roots; runner overhead is below 5 ms per task excluding solve.

packages.title: Mechanism memory, promotion, uncertainty, and deprecation
packages.objective: Make experience measurably reduce future demonstrations or CPU search while correctness remains verifier-controlled.
packages.deliverables: Mechanism store, support geometry, task-local and later ontology-definition adapters, proposal retrieval, offline promotion, fixed-budget memory-off ablation, and deprecation workflow.
packages.acceptance_criteria: GLL-2 passes: at least 50% lower median search and fewer demonstrations on a frozen related test set, no exact-accuracy regression on related or unrelated sets, transferred modules rebind across values, sizes, counts, and layouts, and zero unverified accepts.

packages.title: Local multi-process cognitive swarm
packages.objective: Run heterogeneous agents concurrently on one CPU machine with deterministic artifact merging and exact accounting.
packages.deliverables: Coordinator, resource broker, worker runtime, leases, journals, local transport, crash recovery, and scaling benchmark.
packages.acceptance_criteria: S0 speed gates; semantic results identical across worker counts; zero lost accepted artifacts after crash recovery; coordinator overhead below 5% on four-worker search-heavy suite; each role CPU reported.

packages.title: Distributed swarm transport and integrity
packages.objective: Extend the artifact/job protocol across CPU nodes without trusting remote producers.
packages.deliverables: Versioned framed transport, authenticated optional identities, resumable blob fetch, backpressure, node-loss recovery, and corruption tests.
packages.acceptance_criteria: S2 gates; four-node task-sharded overhead below 15%; corrupted artifacts rejected; no semantic difference from local run; node loss completes remaining tasks; transport can be disabled without core changes.

packages.title: Generic temporal evidence, entity tracking, and interactive adapter SDK
packages.objective: Normalize generic observation-action-outcome histories into compressed temporal evidence without depending on ARC adapters.
packages.deliverables: Temporal observations, candidate tracks, change events, action records, viewport hypotheses, history summaries, replayable episode store, and ARC-AGI-3 as a separate adapter.
packages.acceptance_criteria: Correct event/track in top three for at least 95% controlled suite; working-memory size grows sublinearly and remains below configured cap for 10,000 steps; raw episode replay exact; common update below 100 ms.

packages.title: World-theory induction, hidden state, goal hypotheses, and intervention design
packages.objective: Learn previously unseen action-conditioned dynamics and choose informative, goal-relevant experiments from generic temporal evidence.
packages.deliverables: World theories, latent state schemas, executable goal hypotheses, belief updates, expected-information intervention proposals.
packages.acceptance_criteria: GLL-4, I0, and I1 pass; active policy uses at least 30% fewer actions than random; transition prediction is at least 95%; executable goal is top-three at least 90%; efficiency improves over episodes; learned options transfer to changed layouts; no arbitrary per-step latent labels.

packages.title: Belief-aware planning and option induction
packages.objective: Plan through learned theories, compose independently learned mechanisms, and compress repeated successful behavior into verified options.
packages.deliverables: Deterministic A*, contingent AO*, bounded MCTS, plan certificates, option theories, and planner selection policy.
packages.acceptance_criteria: GLL-3 and I2 pass; independently learned mechanisms compose without a coded composite operator; options reduce expansions at least 5 times on held-out layouts; deterministic small-world plans are optimal; plan replay is exact.

packages.title: Modality frontend SDK and vector-graphics frontend
packages.objective: Define the generic observation extension boundary early and prove it on an exact non-grid visual modality.
packages.deliverables: Frontend trait, uncertainty conventions, source-reference schema, verifier hook, and graphics-to-REG adapter.
packages.acceptance_criteria: Supported graphics subset round-trips exactly; transformation tasks can be represented and verified through core Theory IR; new frontend compiles without modifying core crates; adapter median below 50 ms for moderate scenes.

packages.title: CPU vision frontend spike
packages.objective: Measure whether classical and compact non-transformer CPU perception can supply useful uncertain REG evidence from natural images.
packages.deliverables: Image loader, edges/regions/contours/keypoints, candidate scene graph, uncertainty calibration, and benchmark report.
packages.acceptance_criteria: Pre-registered benchmark metrics met or an honest negative report; no GPU library loaded; inference fits declared CPU latency and memory; uncertain detections never treated as exact facts by verifier.

packages.title: CPU audio and video frontend spikes
packages.objective: Test temporal modality normalization into entities, events, tracks, and relations.
packages.deliverables: Audio event graph, video tracking adapter, temporal uncertainty, and measured limits.
packages.acceptance_criteria: Meet separately pre-registered event and tracking metrics; no unbounded active history; CPU-only attestation; one end-to-end transformation or planning demo per modality with replayable evidence.

packages.title: Proof-backed knowledge subsystem and transformer-free text frontend
packages.objective: Acquire typed, temporal, contradictory, source-linked declarative knowledge and executable schemas, with constrained text as one frontend.
packages.deliverables: Claim store, temporal validity, provenance, entity-resolution proposals, contradiction artifacts, causal and taxonomic indexes, executable schema promotion, tokenizer, chart parser, semantic frames, and source citations.
packages.acceptance_criteria: Every claim has replayable sources and temporal scope; contradictions coexist; entity merges are reversible proposals; executable schemas pass verifier and promotion gates; controlled-language parse bar is pre-registered and met or honestly reported; no transformer dependency.

packages.title: General-learning benchmark harness, evidence packs, and gated evaluation
packages.objective: Make all three learning loops and every architecture claim reproducible, quarantined, comparable, and attributable.
packages.deliverables: Generic problem runner, GLL-1 through GLL-6 suites, JSONL metrics, memory/action ablations, report validator, confidence intervals, preregistration templates, sealed adapter evaluation workflow, and dashboard data.
packages.acceptance_criteria: All report self-tests pass; frozen memory-on/off and active/random comparisons enforce equal budgets; one three-domain dummy suite reproduces byte-identical summaries; verifier is required for success; standard evidence packs are automatic; overhead is below 2%.

packages.title: End-to-end general-learning integration, profiling, and release runtime
packages.owned_scope: top-level `cairn` binary, integration configuration, release profiles
packages.objective: Integrate one cognition runtime across static induction, continual learning, interactive causal learning, knowledge use, and three adapters.
packages.deliverables: Single-node and swarm runtimes, staged budgets, checkpoint/resume, three-loop metrics, failure taxonomy, profiling reports, three-domain evidence packs, and optional ARC adapter reports.
packages.acceptance_criteria: GLL-1 through GLL-6 pass or an honest narrowed-scope report is published; one core revision runs grid transformation, gridworld, and vector graphics; all predictions and plans are independently verified; resource targets are reported; release binary passes attestation.
